title: The Long Night
feeling: Quiet, the weather that does nothing

notes.title: Doing nothing
notes.science: Goalkeepers facing a penalty almost always dive, though staying in the middle would stop more shots. Doing something feels better than waiting, even when waiting works.
notes.limits: The stillness here changes nothing in the sim.
notes.counter: Some say waiting is only a way to avoid acting.
notes.question: When is it best to do nothing?

sources.label: Action Bias among Elite Soccer Goalkeepers, Bar-Eli and others, 2007
